+220%. One Dubai office area tripled in price since 2020. Which one?

Median sale price per sq ft, ready offices, 12 areas, 2016 to 2025:
JVC: 418 to 1,339 AED (+220%)
The Greens: 1,000 to 3,146 AED (+215%)
Barsha Heights: 543 to 1,650 AED (+204%)
Downtown is still the most expensive at 5,110 AED per sq ft.

AED 20.3 billion of Dubai offices sold in 9 months of 2026. More than any full year in DLD data since 2009.

Registered office sales in Dubai:
2020: AED 1.0bn
2025: AED 13.2bn
2026, Jan to 5 Oct: AED 20.3bn, of which 80% off-plan

+187%. That's how much office rents grew in one Dubai area since 2020.

Median new-lease rent per sq ft a year, 12 areas, 2020 to 2025:

The Greens: 100 to 266 AED (+166%)

Asked is an opinion. Paid is a fact.

Dubai office rents, AED per sq ft a year: listings vs signed Ejari leases in 2026.
Barsha Heights: asked 227, paid 135 (+68%)
Sheikh Zayed Rd: asked 240, paid 150 (+60%)
The Greens: asked 415, paid 289 (+44%)
Deira: asked 121, paid 87 (+39%)

Negotiating a lease? Start from what was signed, not what is listed.

From 558 to 1,766 AED per sq ft. Dubai office prices since the Aug 2020 low.

Median sale price of ready offices, all Dubai, 3-month rolling:
2015: around 1,160 AED
Aug 2020: 558 AED, the low
Mar 2023: back above 1,000
Apr 2026: 1,766 AED, the record
